title: CfpcFunctionContract
description: K'UHUL semantic function contract. @kind must be semantic.function.v1. Pattern Induction Guard: promote_generated_facts MUST be false under @policy — any other value is a schema violation. owner_micronaut (ownership) and @backend.capability (execution) are separate and may reference different Micronauts.

@intent.description: Optional semantic intent; defaults to 'resolve' when absent.

@owner.description: Owner Micronaut identifier. Declares ownership; distinct from the execution backend.

@governs.description: Semantic vocabulary terms this function governs. Used for FunctionRegistry indexing.

@capabilities.description: Capability labels this function can provide.

@bindings.description: Typed wildcard bindings. Keys are binding names; values are typed binding specs. Caller must satisfy required bindings in query captures at invoke time.

@backend.description: Execution backend declaration. Absent @backend means no explicit provider — dispatch returns Unresolved (no-exec) unless allow_dynamic_resolution=true.

max_depth.description: Dispatch depth budget. 0 yields ExecutionFailed immediately.

allow_dynamic_resolution.description: If false and @backend is absent, dispatch returns Unresolved without execution.

promote_generated_facts.description: Pattern Induction Guard — MUST be false. Grammar-level invariant, not a runtime policy. No parser may accept true.
